editorial:
Imagine waking up to a psychic telling you your future looks grim, and instead of panicking, you decide to lean into the chaos. That is exactly what Zelda Pickford does in this wild ride. You get thrown into a New Year's Eve party that starts off fancy but quickly turns into a messy disaster. The vibe is a mix of high-society drama and awkward comedy, where everyone is hiding something and a love triangle makes things even more tense. You will feel like you are sitting right there at the table, watching these people make the worst possible choices for their own lives.

The acting is great because the characters feel like real, flawed people who just cannot stop talking. While the pace is a bit slow at first, the twists keep you interested enough to see how it all crashes down. If you like stories about rich people losing their cool, you will love this. You should definitely check it out by renting it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you really like the style, grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The party ends in total chaos as the love triangle finally explodes. You see that Zelda's attempts to control her fate actually caused the very problems she feared. The twist is that the psychic's warning was a self-fulfilling prophecy. By trying to avoid a bad outcome, Zelda pushed everyone toward a breaking point. The movie wraps up by leaving you to wonder if they were doomed from the start or just foolish.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves character studies and messy relationships.
